main_effect:

[Your Turn] When effects trash cards from under this Tamer, by suspending this Tamer, 1 of your [Glowing Dawn] trait Digimon gains ＜Jamming＞ (This Digimon can't be deleted in battles against Security Digimon.) for the turn.
